correctness.rationale: All lengths n>=6 factor into a length-three prefix, n-6 unrestricted middle symbols, and length-three suffix. Each forbidden overlap depends solely on the boundary triple pair. The resulting exact maximum equals 3^(n-6)*max_P |P|*(27-|union B(p)|). A recursion and a separately implemented Gray-code exhaustive pass each cover all 134217728 prefix subsets and agree on maximum 72, all 42 equality masks, profile distribution and four group orbits. Direct 72-word pair testing checks construction validity. Every equality case forces a full Cartesian product, yielding 42 distinct codes for every n>=6, not just numerical extrapolation. Exhaustiveness follows from the bit-mask-to-subset bijection and unpruned loops; the self-contained attached C++17 checker was executed successfully.

value.rationale: Restricted short overlaps model frame synchronization without imposing arbitrary longer-overlap bans. The three-letter alphabet and forbidden overlap lengths 1..3 are the first small q-ary extension beyond published general exact k=2 cases. Known q-ary constructions include 72*3^(n-6), but only an unrestricted sharpness proof and complete 42-optimizer/orbit classification say whether the scheme is optimal and enumerate every equally efficient design. The exact upper bound and equality structure, rather than just reproducibility of a small table, motivate the contribution.
